notes.title: Small fixes | Update 3.0.6
notes.content:
Dear Adventurer,
we're checking in for a short moment! There were some small issues we could not keep in the game. They mainly affected those who play [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] on low-end devices with a low framerate.

Bugfixes with this small update include:[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the text display speed in the tutorial and upon starting the third dungeon for the first time would be limited to your framerate.
[*]Increased performance minimally.
[*]Fixed a few minor bugs.
[/list]

Found some more bugs? Let us know on our official [url=https://discord.gg/4vDSNNs]Discord server[/url].

[i]With best regards
Tim "Beatless" B., Director of Not Another Dungeon?!

P.S.: We are working hard on our next title and are eager to show you what this entails. We will be showing you the results of our work once we feel like it's ready. Thanks for your patience!
[/i]

notes.title: The Tutorial's here! | Update 3.0.4
notes.content:
Dear Adventurer,
we are finally able to release the new tutorial with this update! New players should now be able to learn the game within these 6 short chapters, expanding the lore around Alexandrett, our protagonist, a little bit more!

This update includes:[list]
[*]Added the tutorial. Accompany Alexandrett on her way to the Tower of Imalsrith in this short adventure! (The tutorial panels which were displayed upon starting the game for the first time have been removed.)
[*]Fixed the cutscene playing before entering the Frozen Castle for the first time.
[*]The heroes from our collaboration with [i]Spell Of Darkness[/i] are now able to be bought with Soul Ashes.
[*]A few heroes had their voicelines re-recorded with another Voice Actor: Alice, Licht, Cim'Tame and Sympa.
[*]Fixed a bug where Alice's effect would trigger off of drawing a Guild.
[*]Fixed a few sound bugs within the pause menu.
[*]Fixed a few minor bugs.[/list]
Found some more bugs? Let us know on our official [url=https://discord.gg/4vDSNNs]Discord server[/url].


[h3]Developer's Note[/h3]
[i]From now on, development for Not Another Dungeon?! will rest indefinitely. We are working hard on our next title and will need all of our resources for that.
We want to thank you all for your continuous support and love you showed for the game.

Thanks to your efforts, Alexandrett conquered the Tower of Imalsrith. You sealed the evil within the dark basement lurking beneath your feet. And finally, Alice, Kitai and Shiori are reunited after all those years.

Not Another Dungeon?! is a game about friendship and how working together can help you overcome the biggest obstacles in life.[/i]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/923610318893121606/1128055189530738798/Unbenannt.jpg[/img]

We are thrilled to show you what we've got in store! See you soon, dear Adventurer!

[i]With best regards
Tim "Beatless" B., Director of Not Another Dungeon?![/i]

notes.title: Preparing for the third round | Version 3.0.0 releases December 3rd!
notes.content:
[i]Dear Adventurer,[/i]
after some time, the date for the next big update has finally been set! Thanks to all of your feedback, we can make [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] a better experience for everyone. Although we probably overshot the mark a little bit, because we (again) recoded a good chunk of the entire game.

If you have feedback or feel that any of the changes aren't right for the game, feel free to let us know on our [url=https://discord.gg/4vDSNNs]Discord Server[/url].

[h3]The Factions' Identities[/h3]
Until now, factions haven't really defined the style of their cards' effects - we aim to change that with modified and new effects. The individual factions get their own face - so if you like big card synergies, for example, you will find joy in the units of the Empire of Fractile.

[h3]The User Interface[/h3]
The User Interface has irritated many players, which is why we have completely redesigned the main menu and other menus. Your inbox disappears, the quests have been restructured again.

[h3]The Backstories[/h3]
We felt it was the right idea to keep the backstories of each character very much in the background so far. Outside of the tutorial, you can still pretty much ignore these if you're only interested in gameplay. Since the interest in the background stories, especially Alice's, was greater than initially thought, we have tried to bring you the background details a little closer - there is a new submenu in the menu for this purpose, which shows a map of Ursus, the continent, as well as some important places there. We added more meetup lines (conversations that happen when two specific characters meet). Also, certain actions trigger short sections of the storytelling. Don't worry, these can also be skipped by the press of a button.

[h3]The Tutorial[/h3]
[i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] isn't as one-dimensional as it was a year ago (back then there were no Blessings, far fewer Ability Cards, and Alice was the only unit that could meister!). Many players still don't know what to do with souls. That's why we revised the tutorial and divided it into several small chunks. We also want to bring out the backstories of the characters a bit more. As a reward for completing all tutorial chapters, you'll get a powerful new hero with a brand new type of status effect! So it's also worth playing the new tutorial as a returning player!

[h3]The Structure[/h3]
So far, everything in the logic of [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] has taken place pretty much at the same time (we don't even want to start with the coin toss at this point), but that damages the clarity. That's why we reprogrammed a large part of the gameplay to make the game more performant and above all more structured: There are now dedicated time slots for (almost) every action. Once again we rely on your feedback!

Like last time, the new update includes a lot of new content, such as a new booster pack with 21 new heroes, many new collectibles and a brand new dungeon. There are also 3 new status effects, 5 new action cards, daily login rewards and much more! I don't want to get too specific here, you'll have to wait for the update itself to find out exactly what's new.

As compensation for the long wait, there will be also 1 free booster pack of the first expansion, "Wings Of A New Beginning", for everyone*! This booster pack contains a lot of powerful units for the later levels, which is especially valuable at the beginning of the game, since the starter deck doesn't contain that many units for the later levels!
[i]*You will automatically receive the booster pack when you start version 3.0.0.[/i]

[i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] will release its version 3.0.0 on December 3rd, 2022. From 10:00 a.m. CST / 04.00 a.m. EST there will also be a stream on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1739100/Not_Another_Dungeon]Steam page[/url] and our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/daggerbunnystudios]Twitch channel[/url], hosted by SakuraiVA!

If you have feedback or just want to talk to other players and us developers, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/4vDSNNs]discord server[/url].

[i]Best regards
Tim "Beatless" B., Director of Not Another Dungeon?![/i]

notes.title: The Lords Of Steam are here! | Time-limited event: Full Steam Ahead
notes.content:
[i]Dear Adventurer,[/i]
we are excited to announce our second time-limited event!

Together with a few minor balance changes and bug fixes, we're introducing 4 new event heroes to [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] - The Lords Of Steam. With their brand new technology, the [b][i]Steam Generator TX-41[/i][/b], they are able to summon powerful Steamcloud Beasts, and, if the circumstances are right, the powerful boss hero "Nimbus, Uppermost Lord Of Steam"! The new [b]LINK[/b] system allows for cards to link themselves to other units, in order to get access to more powerful effects! Only 2 cards are using this system right now [i](one of which is an event card you can unlock right now)[/i], but we're looking forward to adding more of them in the future!

Start [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] from [b]June 1st 2022 - August 31st 2022[/b] to receive four (4) new, time-limited quests with which, after completing them, you can unlock four (4) new heroes and one (1) new profile icon from this event, [b][i]Full Steam Ahead[/i][/b]!

We also added one new hidden achievement. Can you find out what you need to do to unlock it?

You can obtain the following heroes:
[list]
[*]Cirrus, Lord Of Steam - Event Quest
[*]Mieh, Lord Of Steam - Event Quest
[*]Stratus, Lord Of Steam - Event Quest
[*]Tyndall, Lord Of Steam - Event Quest
[*]Lully, Dreamkeeper - Bonus Code "LULLY"
[*]Krystix, Nightshade - Bonus Code "KRYSTIX"
[/list]

Also, a new enemy has been added to the Tower's Basement:
[list]
[*]Scrap Soldier
[/list]

And two new tokens have been added. The Lords Of Steam use them!
[list]
[*]Steamcloud Beast
[*]Nimbus, Uppermost Lord Of Steam
[/list]

We also adjusted the balance of a few Ability Cards:
[list]
[*]Misfire: Removed x2 damage multiplicator
[*]Breakwater: Added x2 damage multiplicator
[/list]

And, finally, a few minor bugs were fixed:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where Para, Iyu, Ken and Ashe would not be added to your collection after completing their quests. When you start [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] the next time, they will be automatically added to your collection.
[*]Fixed a bug where event quests would not be displayed in the small quest lists.
[*]Fixed a bug where the game could would be stuck in the hero selector upon Alexandrett being defeated, but no heroes being available to recruit.
[*]Fixed a bug where sometimes card details would still be visible after the cursor being set invisible or the time being paused.
[*]Fixed a bug with the quest check not working as intended.
[*]Fixed other minor bugs.
[/list]

Starting the game in the said timespan will add the event quests to your quest list on startup. Once redeemed, the quests are here to stay. So make sure to get them while they are here!

The new Ability Card system as well as the other reworked mechanics seem to be a good addition accoding to your wonderful feedback. Thanks for that! We're working hard on making [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] a more enjoyable experience with each update.

We now start working on version 3.0.0, which includes a new dungeon [i](some say some hints can be found within the collectable letters)[/i], a new booster pack and more! For more information, please stay tuned!

[i]With steam-filled regards,
Tim "Beatless" B., Director of Not Another Dungeon?!

P.S.: Join our [url=https://discord.gg/4vDSNNs]Discord Server[/url] to interact with the developers and other players![/i]

notes.title: Getting ready for the second round | Version 2.0.0 releases May 1st!
notes.content:
[i]Dear Adventurer,[/i]
we received a lot of really valueable feedback. Thanks for that! In this event post, I'll be talking a bit about what some of the most common things were the players did not like about the game and how we are approaching on changing them for the better. We recoded a good chunk of the entire game, too.

If you want to give us your feedback or think that one of the changes is not doing the right thing for the game, feel free to tell us on our Discord Server.

[h3]Gameplay Depth[/h3]
[i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] is a casual experience. Some would say, it's gameplay is flat. A lot of things do not have any meaningful impact. We want to change that, but not forget the simplistic approach which makes [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i]. We simply want to add more to discover. And by that, we mean a [b]lot[/b] more to discover. We really like the "easy to learn, hard to master" aspect of our game and by adding a lot more of diversity and [i]bit[/i] more of complexity, we aim to make [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] a better experience for both casual and tryhard gamers.

[h3]The Ability Card System[/h3]
The by far worst-received feature of the current state of [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] is the Ability Card System - The cards on your hand which you draw from your deck. They simply have almost no impact right now - except for the Guild, which is, and is for all times going to be, the key to our gameplay. We just wanted the other Ability Cards to feel more diverse and impactful. While the old cards were mostly small tools to help the player perfecting enemies (bringing them to exactly 0 health to gain bonus points), we wanted to rework that entire system. Not only did we add a lot of more Ability Cards, we also introduced a whole lot of new mechanics (like Shields and Status Effects) which they bring to the table as well as a system to keep early-game cards relevant until the end: Scaling. Cards like Quick Punch will not deal 1 damage, but instead 1->5, which means that the strength of the card increases while progressing through the dungeon. This, combined with the less cards a new hero adds to your deck, should make for some more strategic, diverse and fun runs.

[h3]Abilities[/h3]
We simply changed or removed any abilites from units that we thought have no impact on the game at all. Abilities used multiple times were put into so-called "Status Effects", which can be seen on the bottom of the card. Those keywords replace the buffs, such as Puppy Protection and the Banners. Units that you receive later in the game have more complex effects than those you start with, although we try to keep the card effects as simple as possible.

[h3]Quality Of Life[/h3]
"Why do I have to choose a target for every single Ability Card, even if it does not have any effect on the selected unit?" - We are changing that. Instead of dragging all Ability Cards on a target, we changed it so you drag the card you want to use in the center of the screen and then select your target(s) (yes, we do have a few new Ability Cards which require more than one target). Although this takes a bit of time to get used to, we found this approach to be a lot less frustrating and clear than the old one. We are still thinking about adding an option to revert to the old system, but this is really unlikely.

Of course, we are also adding a lot of new content, such as a new Booster Pack with 21 new heroes, a few new collectables and a brand-new dungeon into the game. I don't want to get too specific here, you'll have to wait for the update itself to find out what exactly is new. 

[i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] will release it's version 2.0.0 May 1st, 2022.

If you have any feedback or just want to talk to other players and us developers, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/4vDSNNs]Discord-Server[/url].

[i]With best regards
Tim "Beatless" B., Director of Not Another Dungeon?![/i]

notes.title: Thank you for this 2021!
notes.content:
[i]Dear Adventurer,[/i]
as 2021 is slowly coming to an end, we would like to review the year 2021 from a developer's and player's perspective.

[h3]What happened? | Milestones[/h3]
[list]
[*]August 2021: The Steam page for [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] is released to the public.
[*]October 29th 2021: The release date for [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] is announced: November 19th!
[*]November 19th 2021: [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] is finally released in Version 1.0.0. [url=https: //twitter.com/SakuraiVA]SakuraiVA[/url] streams the game on our Steam site.
[*]November 2021: [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] receives its first bug fix patches.
[*]December 1st 2021: The first medium-sized update for [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] is released. In addition to a revision of the high score system, [url=https: //twitter.com/SakuraiVA]SakuraiVA[/url] receives his own card.[/list]

[h3]Developer's View[/h3]
Even if [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] has not even been released for a whole month by the time we write this, we would like to say a big thank you to all of you. You made this a wonderful year for us developers. It might not seem like it to gamers, but every download, review, and comment made our day better. We didn't expect such a small project to have such a great community.
Whether it's Alex, our Lead Writer, who is really happy about the slightest increase in the number of players, or Tarik, our Lead Composer, who can't really understand the praise for his fantastic soundtrack - we're really grateful for everyone who enjoys this adventure with us.
That gives us the incentive to work at full speed on new content for [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i]. We really look forward to bringing you more content in the not too distant future!

[i]"The release went better than we could even have imagined. We thank you all for your positive feedback." - Alexander "Archangel" H., Lead Writer of Not Another Dungeon?![/i] 

[h3]Player' View[/h3]
[i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] had two larger, closed beta tests prior to release, which were mostly attended by the Voice Actors and some of our friends.
After the first, longer test phase in June 2021, a lot of feedback had really built up, but we had all worked through until the second, shorter test phase in August. It wasn't a little work, but it was definitely worth the effort.
Minor rivalries have formed on the leaderboards. Content creators have created content on different platforms. It's almost a bit surreal.

[i]"I always found the collaboration to be very pleasant and I love to see how much the community's opinion is taken into account both before the release during the beta phase and after the release." - Brian "Titankämpfer" R., Tester and Voice Actor of Para [/i] 

[h3]Finally[/h3]
Thank you so much for this fantastic year. We thank everyone who helped us, all Voice Actors, all players and of course you for reading this article! We hope 2022 will be even better! We will do our utmost to achieve this.

With best regards
[i]Tim "Beatless" B., Director of Not Another Dungeon?!

P.S.: We can't wait to send you information about version 2.0.0! Stay tuned![/i]

notes.title: Gameplay Adjustments and Balance Changes | Patchnotes Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
[i]Dear Adventurer,[/i]
this month we'd like to make some major adjustments to the game.
Among other things, these changes prevent the boring high-score strategy of [i]"Guildinizing"[/i] (Defeating all opponents on the level except for one weak opponent and then wait until you have played all guilds from your deck - Recruiting always gave a lot of points). We also tried to make the game more enjoyable. Bosses should now feel more like bosses and less like plain noise. 

[b]System:[/b][list]
[*]Adjusted the animation when meistering. The meister is no longer seen in the middle of the battlefield while the original unit is still transforming. 
[*]Some probabilities were adjusted.
[*]The gold received after a session was decreased.
[*]The experience points received after a session were increased.[/list]

[b]High Score Calculation:[/b][list]
[*][u][b]NEW:[/b][/u] Score for conquering a level in just one turn: [i]+200 points[/i]
[*][u][b]ADJUSTED:[/b][/u] Recruiting heroes no longer gives points when replacing a hero with a guild.
[*][b][u]ADJUSTED:[/u][/b] The bonus points were greatly decreased.
[*]Score for recruiting: [i]Now +200 points [/i]
[*]Score for conquering the Tower: [i]Now +2,500 points[/i]

notes.title: Time-limited Event: Call Of Zefral
notes.content:
Dear Adventurer,
we are very excited to announce our first time-limited event and cross over!

[i]"Evil creatures known as Dreadlings are fast approaching to threaten the world balance and mankind. In a world of might and magic, engulfed in conflict since centuries past, it’s your role to stand up for all, gather your allies and solve the remaining mysteries."[/i] - Those are the words that describe [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1148710/Miriel_Saga/]Miriel Saga[/url][/i], a JRPG created by our friends over at [i]NG+ Studios[/i]. During the development of [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i], they helped us a lot, not only understanding Steam [i](This is our first game released on Steam, after all!)[/i], but also understanding what it really means to develop games as an Indie Developer. We are really grateful for meeting them.

Start [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] from November 19th 2021 - January 16th 2022 to receive five (5) new, time-limited quests with which, after completing them, you can unlock five (5) new heroes from [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1148710/Miriel_Saga/]Miriel Saga[/url][/i]!

You can obtain the following heroes:
[list]
[*]Aleister, Orphan Hero
[*]Lilluza, Hero's Familiar
[*]Anya, Harbringer of Firearms
[*]Wendi, The Queen of Ice
[*]Naga, Child Of The Wind
[/list]

Also, a new enemy has been added to the Tower of Imalsrith:
[list]
[*]Dreadling
[/list]

Starting the game in the said timespan will add the event quests to your quest list on startup. Once redeemed, the quests are here to stay. So make sure to get them while they are here!

We want to thank [i]NG+ Studios[/i] for this opportunity. Did you know that [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i] also appears in [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1148710/Miriel_Saga/]Miriel Saga[/url][/i]? You can find more information on that topic [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1148710/view/4557074786231128906]here[/url].

Still happily stacking potions in [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1148710/Miriel_Saga/]Miriel Saga[/url][/i]
Tim "Beatless" B., Director of [i]Not Another Dungeon?![/i]
